coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 18 ground-truth variable items (11%): a no-lookup condition and accuracy measurement. General discussion of retrieval and QA does not identify the required datasets.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes an unspecified long-context backbone and CPU environment for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 with InfLLM, a 4K window, and A100/A800 fp16 execution. It omits the prescribed memory constants and replaces full/decoding-only/no-lookup ablations and representative-token/mean-key representations with different mechanisms, chunk granularities, and variable context lengths. Retrieve.KV and Math.F are not specified, and accuracy is not the common metric across all tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the findings that full memory lookup improves performance, removing lookup nearly collapses Retrieve.KV accuracy, and representative-token selection outperforms mean representation.
